actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident3 gave >30 last round, so I punish with max severity (235) and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules. Observe last round contributions: Resident3 120.75, Resident5 120.75, Resident6 40.75. Any >30? Yes all three >30. Need punish any resident who contributed more than 30 units in most recent round. Should punish each? Rule: "If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost))." It says any other resident, singular? Could punish each. Likely punish each. Max severity = floor(wallet / 0.3) = floor(70.61/0.3)= floor(235.366)=235 severity units. But punishment cost per unit is 0.3, total cost = severity *0.3 = 70.5 which is within wallet 70.61. So can punish one resident with severity 235. But can't punish multiple because cost adds up. Must choose at most one physical action. So choose punish one resident, perhaps the one contributed >30. Choose Resident3. severity 235. That will reduce Resident3 wallet by 235 (floored to zero). Cost 70.5 leaving ~0.11. Ok.

Also broadcast discouraging message.

Return actions list with punish and broadcast.

Explanation.
